description: Requests human intervention and pauses automated state-changing work on a page.

pageId.description: Page ID to pause for human intervention.

reason.description: Short explanation of what the human needs to do.

purpose.description: Describe the exact human intervention needed, e.g., solving a CAPTCHA, completing login, approving a purchase, or reviewing ambiguous content

pageId.description: Page ID whose automated work is paused.

state.description: Page pause state after the request.

paused.description: Whether the page is paused after the request.

alreadyPaused.description: Whether the page was already paused before the request.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.
